info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Commission Details Retrieval API
info.description: The Commission Details Retrieval API allows users to access detailed information regarding specific sales commissions identified by their commissionId. This endpoint serves financial analysts and sales team members who require insights into commission structures and historical data for performance tracking. The API provides essential data to facilitate informed decision-making and reporting within the sales departments. Leveraging this API, businesses can optimize their incentive programs and better understand their compensation strategies.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific sales commission record
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details of a specific sales commission identified by its unique resource ID. It provides information relevant to the commission, enabling you to understand its components and related data.

requestBody.description: This request body allows the client to retrieve commission information for a specific sales record identified by RES-100045. Ensure that the JSON payload contains all required fields as defined in the schema.

GetSalesCommissionByIdRequest.title: Sales Commissions Request Body
GetSalesCommissionByIdRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the operations associated with sales commissions.
